cells.name: retained-96gib-residency
cells.rationale: Existing endpoint fixes TPS but lacks lifecycle smaps/process-I/O attribution. Three post-fill forwards bound the new cost while exposing sustained pressure.

cells.name: control-64gib-residency
cells.rationale: Pressure-free control supplies the required resident model working-set budget and causal disappearance test; it is diagnostic and cannot alter the fixed 96-GiB gate. After the 96-GiB cell showed that each full smaps walk materially perturbs fill timing, this plan was narrowed before execution to one post-fill VMA snapshot plus the continuous lightweight series and automatic terminal snapshot.
